hero.headline: Your taxes, filed right, by someone who picks up the phone.
hero.subtext: Kaya for Accounting & Tax Services Inc. handles personal, self-employment, business and corporate returns, GST/HST filing, and year-round bookkeeping — with one person accountable for your file from intake to e-file confirmation.

services.title: Personal income tax returns
services.description: E-filed personal returns, prepared and reviewed before they're sent.

services.title: Self-employment tax returns
services.description: Business-use-of-home, vehicle expenses, and income reporting done properly.

services.title: Business income tax returns
services.description: Corporate returns prepared alongside your bookkeeping, not disconnected from it.

services.title: Complete accounting & bookkeeping
services.description: Monthly or quarterly books kept current, reconciled, and ready for tax time.

services.title: GST/HST returns
services.description: Registration, filing, and reconciliation for GST/HST-registered businesses.
